updates.convicted: Convicted June 8, 1961 of breach of the peace
updates.sentence: Sentenced June 8, 1961 to four months, with two months suspended, and a $200 fine. Held at Hinds County Jail and transferred to Parchman June 23. Released in July 1961; exact discharge day remains unresolved because the archival finding aid gives July 14 while the published diary is described as forty days of custody.

entries.rationale: Preserve June7 arrest from first-person diary over June8 finding-aid arrest error. Finding aid documents sentencing June8 and releaseJuly14, publisher reports40days; retain only agreed July release month pending diary discharge entry. No false exact counter.
